title: 第148章 第二期正式播出
slug: 综艺大导演从齐聚初代跑男开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

其实争吵也是一种热度。

毕竟黑红也是红嘛。

这段时间的跨平台骂战，让网上很多原本不关注跑男的路人也开始好奇起来。

毕竟不是所有人都看过跑男，都喜欢跑男的。

那么这到底是一档什么样的节目呢？

能让这么多人爱了那么多年！

于是这些人也开始抱着试一试的心态，

想要在第一时间看到跑男的节目，就必须在周五晚八点的时候

除非愿意等到明天中午十二点看重播。

但绝大多数人都已经苦苦等了一个星期。

再让他们等一天是绝对等不了的。

而只要这些人愿意

快到八点，吴凡也

他早早就已经赶到了海城，在这里住下了。

虽然明天要录节目，但今天第二期播出那也是要看的。

一个收视率那也是收视率啊。

吴凡把遥控器放在腿上，安静的看着电视。

这江卫视的台标，在屏幕左上角显示着。

哪怕吴凡早就看过成片无数遍了，毕竟每一帧画面都是他自己亲手剪出来的。

但他还是想在今晚，以一个普通观众的身份坐在电视机前。

手机上则是时刻刷着网上的即时评论。

他要第一时间看见观众们的反馈如何。

毕竟吴凡怕让观众失望。

第一期效果很好，那么观众对第二期就会更加期待。

所以节目效果必须比第一期更完美。

粉丝们苦苦等了一周。

当然不能让他们失望。

吴凡希望他们在看到泥潭夺旗的时候可以笑出来。

看到何润冬那身银白战甲时，会起鸡皮疙瘩。

尤其是驻马河上全员渡江成功的时候，那种团魂燃烧的兴奋感。

这才是他做节目的终极目标。

让所有观众都因为节目内容而兴奋。

节目终于播出了。

《超级英雄》的前奏从千家万户的电视音响里同时传出来。

无数个家庭的客厅里，都出现了《奔跑吧初代》五个大字。

当何润冬身披银白战甲从偏殿黑暗中走出来，陈到明跨过门槛。

项羽和刘邦的再次见面。

Page (1/3)

In fact, quarrel is also a kind of heat.

After all, black and red are also red.

The cross-platform scolding war during this period has made many passers-by on the Internet who did not originally pay attention to Running Man become curious.

After all, not everyone has seen Running Man or likes him.

So what kind of show is this?

To be loved by so many people for so many years!

So these people began to have the mentality of giving it a try.

If you want to watch Running Man as soon as possible, you must watch it on Friday night at 8pm

Unless you are willing to wait until 12 noon tomorrow to watch the replay.

But most people have been waiting for a week.

They absolutely can't wait another day.

And as long as these people are willing

It's almost eight o'clock, Wu Fan is also

He had arrived in Haicheng early and stayed here.

Although the program will be recorded tomorrow, the second episode will be broadcast today and you still have to watch it.

A ratings rating is also a ratings rating.

Wu Fan put the remote control on his lap and watched TV quietly.

The Jiang TV logo is displayed in the upper left corner of the screen.

Even though Wu Fan has watched the finished film countless times, after all, he cut out every frame by himself.

But he still wanted to sit in front of the TV tonight as an ordinary viewer.

On my mobile phone, I am always reading real-time comments on the Internet.

He wants to see the audience's feedback immediately.

After all, Wu Fan is afraid of disappointing the audience.

The first issue was very effective, so the audience will look forward to the second issue even more.

Therefore, the program effect must be more perfect than the first episode.

Fans have been waiting for a week.

Of course we can't let them down.

Wu Fan hopes they can laugh when they see Quagmire Capture the Flag.

When you see He Rundong's silver armor, you will get goosebumps.

Especially when everyone successfully crossed the Zhuma River, there was that sense of excitement that the team spirit was burning.

This is the ultimate goal of his program.

Let all viewers be excited by the content of the program.

The show is finally airing.

The prelude to "Superheroes" was heard from the TV speakers in thousands of households at the same time.

The five characters "Run, First Generation" appeared in the living rooms of countless families.

When He Rundong walked out of the darkness of the side hall wearing a silver armor, Chen Daoming crossed the threshold.

Xiang Yu and Liu Bang met again.
